svg.text: Three Conjuncts Carve Gcd(12, 8) = {4} Out of ℕ
Each predicate is a subset of ℕ; conjunction (∧) is region intersection (∩)
Each conjunct eliminates values until one remains
Stage 2: Add P₁ ∧ P₂ (3 common divisors)
Because P₁ ∩ P₂ ∩ P₃ = {4}, any term e : Gcd(12, 8)
is guaranteed at compile time to evaluate to 4.
